title: Testing Conditional Distribution Equality Using Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional distribution equality testing is a core problem with applications in causal inference, model diagnostics, and transfer learning. Existing methods often lose power when the conditioning variable is high-dimensional. We propose a new test that leverages generative models to compare conditional distributions using both observed data and synthetic samples. A sample-splitting and studentization scheme is introduced to control estimation error. Under the null, the test statistic is asymptotically normal, and we establish local power against contiguous alternatives. Our theory under the null and fixed alternative requires only consistency of the learned conditional distribution, allowing for a broad class of generative models. Empirical results demonstrate accurate size control and strong power in high-dimensional settings compared to representative kernel-based conditional and joint two-sample tests.

translated_title: 基于生成模型的条件分布相等性检验
translated_abstract: 条件分布相等性检验是一个核心问题，在因果推断、模型诊断和迁移学习中有着广泛的应用。当条件变量为高维时，现有方法常常会损失检验功效。我们提出了一种新的检验方法，该方法利用生成模型，结合观测数据和合成样本来比较条件分布。我们引入了样本分割和学生化方案来控制估计误差。在原假设下，检验统计量具有渐近正态性，并且我们针对连续邻近备择假设建立了局部功效理论。我们在原假设和固定备择假设下的理论仅要求所学习的条件分布具有一致性，因此可以容纳一大类生成模型。实证结果表明，与代表性的基于核方法的两样本检验相比，该方法在高维设置下实现了精确的检验水平控制和强大的检验功效。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于生成模型的条件分布相等性检验方法，通过结合观测数据与合成样本以及样本分割与学生化技术，在高维条件变量情形下实现了精确的检验水平控制和更强的检验功效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generative model-based test for conditional distribution equality that achieves accurate size control and strong power in high-dimensional settings by leveraging both observed and synthetic data with sample-splitting and studentization techniques.
